method: Read-only source inspection; no model execution
checks: Official Bench EMA uses matching config and initializes the same Native/T1 + role + zero-exit Geo in both arms.
Fresh identical generator AdamW; independent head optimizer; common pre-registered parent, augmentation, noise, time and permutation identities.
Official full-object normalization and half-scale pre-OT are inherited and bitwise checked.
PLAIN matches all free faces; SEAM matches unique source owner faces to edge slots and applies OT only to remaining bulk.
Known C and active seam endpoints have zero velocity target and do not enter free-coordinate FM denominator.
Both arms use HYBRID lambda .25 after matching, with ordinary Gaussian at inference.
Inference extracts only C geometry/topology and total N into isolated condition bundles. Source Y and labels are not passed to head or generator.
Euler50 uses FP32 integration and exact per-step C/anchor writeback under BF16 deterministic forward.
limitations: Source training targets intentionally retain existing duplicate/degenerate/possibly intersecting geometry.
TRAIN64 adaptation may still be undertrained at the fixed update budget.
Seven DEV parents belong to official pretrained test split; one is held out only from adaptation.
Bench is related to Chair, so this is one category-transfer pilot, not broad zero-shot generalization.
Balanced BCE uses this frozen TRAIN pool counts and does not ensure calibrated probabilities.
Generalized layout activation and final geometry still require empirical evaluation.
